_comment: The board's label set — one source, read by both consumers.
`coordinate.sh --init-labels` mints every entry here. `decompose-validate.mjs` derives the
label names a proposal may carry from the same file. They used to be two hand-written lists
that had to agree, and they stopped agreeing: seven program waves (fabric, canvas, frontdoor,
connectors-v2, capabilities, compat, offer-parity) existed on GitHub and were in use, while
the validator rejected all of them as `unknown label` and a fresh repo would never create
them. A decomposition for any of those programs could not be seeded.
`kind` decides how each consumer treats a label:
wave | lane | class  — a proposal must carry exactly one of each
authorable           — a proposal MAY carry it (mutex/needs)
runtime              — maintained by claim-work.sh / coordinate.sh; a proposal must NOT
pre-set it, or it corrupts the claim/blocked bookkeeping
board                — minted for the board, never valid on a proposed unit (e.g. `epic`,
which is an umbrella and is never directly built or claimed)
Adding a program wave is one entry here — nothing else to keep in step.
THIS FILE OVERWRITES THE BOARD. `--init-labels` mints with `gh label create --force`, which
UPDATES an existing label rather than skipping it, so an entry here is not a default — it is
the value the label WILL have. Getting that wrong is not theoretical: on 2026-09-01 the six
waves below were added with freshly-written descriptions, `--init-labels` was run, and four
live labels lost their W-number prefix (W0/W2/W3/W5) while all six were flattened to one
colour. The board carries a SEPARATE wave:W1..W7 numbering, so those prefixes were the only
thing tying the named tracks to it. Restored below from the values recorded in the review of
#3610. When adding a label that already exists on GitHub, copy its live description and
colour verbatim (`gh label list --json name,description,color`) rather than writing new ones.
It drifted a SECOND time, in the other direction: on 2026-09-01 six wave labels were live on
GitHub (e2e-green, byoiac-ga, cli-first, truth, elench-repo, hardening) that this file did not
name, so the validator would have rejected a decomposition onto any of them. Collapsing two
lists into one fixed the two consumers agreeing with EACH OTHER; it does not make either agree
with the board, because `gh label create` still works. This file is the source — mint a wave
HERE and let `--init-labels` push it, never the other way round.
